source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Alcohol Reference, Fantasy Violence, Language, Suggestive ThemesGamesFINAL FANTASY RESONANCEReleases 10/22/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - FINAL FANTASY RESONANCEAlcohol Reference, Fantasy Violence, Language, Suggestive ThemesLoadingView DLCHope resonates within the crystalsReturn to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin. ◆ Cinematic pixel artWhat if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive.◆ A return to the familiarA classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more.◆ Strategic turn-based battlesExploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices.◆ FINAL FANTASY legendsBolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization.◆ Hours of side content to discoverThe world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.Software description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):Pre-order Bonus: Magitek Airship & Squire Starter PackThis set contains an item that transforms your airship’s appearance into a magitek vessel, along with useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.Pack Contents: • Magitek Airship Passkey x1• Knight’s Greatsword x1• Chestplate of Preparation x1 (Increases EXP gained in battle by a certain amount)• Magicite Shard x1• Tent x3• Mist Potion x3*These bonuses are available only to customers who pre-order the product and are not available to customers who purchase the product after release. *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. *The airship’s appearance can be changed by turning the Magitek Airship Passkey “ON” under the Items section of the main menu. Early Purchase Bonus: Squire Kickstart PackThis set contains useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.Pack Contents: • Blessed Cuirass x1 (Increase gil obtained by a certain amount)• Mist Ether x1*These bonuses are available only to customers who purchase the product by November 5, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. (PST). *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. *This game is only compatible with Nintendo Switch™ 2. Please be aware that it cannot be played on Nintendo Switch™.*There is also a Nintendo Switch™ version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. *It is not possible to carry save data from the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version over to the Nintendo Switch™ version.*It is not possible to carry save data from the Nintendo Switch™ version over to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.About this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 8.8 GBNintendo Switch 2: 12.7 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Language, Suggestive Themes, ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesGamesFATAL FURY: City of the Wolves - STANDARD EditionReleases 10/22/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves - STANDARD EditionLanguage, Suggestive Themes, ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingSNK's beloved Fatal Fury series first hit the market in 1991, spearheading the fighting game boom of the 1990s that swept the industry thereafter. Now, the latest in the series—FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves—is set to arrive on Nintendo Switch™ 2 !■All-new REV System supercharges the excitement!Introducing the REV System, a brand-new toolset that offers unique offensive options from the moment the battle begins! Use REV Arts, REV Accel, REV Blows (while S.P.G. is active), and more until you hit your limit and the REV Meter overheats. The all-new REV System—fight at full throttle and supercharge the excitement!■Two control schemes—fun for newcomers and veterans alike!Choose from two control schemes: Arcade Style is based on precise, technical inputs, while Smart Style lets you perform flashy special moves and combos using directional inputs and single button presses. From fighting game newcomers to seasoned veterans, there's plenty of fun and excitement to be had—tailored specifically to your level!■Strive for supremacy in EPISODES OF SOUTH TOWN, a single-player RPG mode!Introducing "Episodes of South Town" (EOST)—a solo RPG adventure where you'll square up against contenders under various fight conditions, earning XP and other rewards for your efforts. Level up your fighter, build out a diverse kit of skills, and dominate the opposition on your way to the top. Dreams and ambitions run rampant in South Town; now is the time to chase the city's crown and carve a legend all of your own!Software description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)30.3 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-2)Online (2-12)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineOnline PlaySave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
